name: A4
description: The Audi A4 traces its lineage to the 1972 Audi 80, the compact sedan that established Audi's position in the premium segment. Through six generations — from the B5 (1994) to the current B10 — the A4 has defined Audi's core proposition: understated luxury, quattro AWD capability, and a driving experience that emphasises composure over excitement.

generations.description: The B5 A4 (1994–2001) introduced the A4 nameplate, replacing the 80. Built on the PL45 platform, it shared architecture with the B5 Passat.
